name: StatedBot0
source:
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DefectBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Program
open PD
namespace PD.Bots
def StatedBot0 (k : Nat) : Prog := .search k (.plays .opp .self Action.C) (.search k (.plays .opp (.bot DefectBot) Action.D) (.const Action.C) (.const Action.D)) (.const Action.D)
end PD.Bots

name: StatedBot1
source:
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CooperateBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DefectBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.MirrorBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Program
open PD
namespace PD.Bots
def StatedBot1 : Prog := .ite (.sim .opp (.bot DefectBot)) Action.C (.const Action.D) (.ite (.sim .opp (.bot CooperateBot)) Action.C (.const Action.C) (.ite (.sim .opp (.bot MirrorBot)) Action.C (.const Action.C) (.const Action.D)))
end PD.Bots
